## 9k. Excluding procedural intubations with >= 4 h procedural time before the ICU (R4.4)
```{r rr-no-long-or}
# Drop patients intubated in a procedural area with >= 4 h of procedural time before ICU arrival
# (all ICU types). Procedural intubations whose stay could not be matched (procedural_stay_found FALSE) are kept.
if ("pre_icu_procedural_hours" %in% names(primary_cohort)) {
  long_or <- as.character(primary_cohort$intubation_site) == "or_procedural" &
             !is.na(primary_cohort$pre_icu_procedural_hours) & primary_cohort$pre_icu_procedural_hours >= 4
  or_removed <- primary_cohort[long_or, .N, by = .(icu_group = fifelse(is_ct_icu(icu_imv), "cardiothoracic_icu", "other_icu"),
                                                   lang_cat_6 = as.character(lang_cat_6))]
  or_removed <- rbind(or_removed, or_removed[, .(N = sum(N)), by = icu_group][, lang_cat_6 := "all"],
                      data.table(icu_group = "all", lang_cat_6 = "all", N = sum(long_or)), use.names = TRUE)
  or_removed <- merge(or_removed,
    rbind(primary_cohort[, .(n_in_primary = .N), by = .(icu_group = fifelse(is_ct_icu(icu_imv), "cardiothoracic_icu", "other_icu"),
                                                         lang_cat_6 = as.character(lang_cat_6))],
          primary_cohort[, .(n_in_primary = .N), by = .(icu_group = fifelse(is_ct_icu(icu_imv), "cardiothoracic_icu", "other_icu"))][, lang_cat_6 := "all"],
          data.table(icu_group = "all", lang_cat_6 = "all", n_in_primary = nrow(primary_cohort)), use.names = TRUE),
    by = c("icu_group", "lang_cat_6"), all = TRUE)
  or_removed[is.na(N), N := 0L]
  or_removed[, pct_removed := round(100 * N / n_in_primary, 2)]
  # Small cells, with complementary suppression: if one language row of an ICU group is hidden, hide both
  or_removed[, hide := N < min_cell]
  or_removed[lang_cat_6 != "all", hide := any(hide), by = icu_group]
  or_removed[hide == TRUE, pct_removed := NA]
  or_removed[, `:=`(site = institution, n_removed = fifelse(hide, paste0("<", min_cell), as.character(N)),
                    n_in_primary = censor_n(n_in_primary), N = NULL, hide = NULL)]
  setcolorder(or_removed, c("site", "icu_group", "lang_cat_6", "n_removed", "n_in_primary", "pct_removed"))
  print(or_removed)
  fwrite(or_removed, file.path(sedation_rr, paste0(institution, "_no_long_or_removed_counts.csv")))
  run_subgroup(relevel_cohort(primary_cohort[!long_or]), "no_long_or_cohort", out_dir = sedation_rr, analysis_group = "sensitivity",
               note = "excludes procedural intubations with >= 4 h procedural time before ICU arrival")
} else record_result(NULL, "sensitivity_model_no_long_or", "sensitivity", "no_long_or_cohort", "percent_deep_sedation_48",
                     status = "input_missing", note = "pre_icu_procedural_hours not in analytic file (part5_procedural_stay.R)")
```

## 10c. Completed-48-hour cohort with inverse-probability-of-completion weights
```{r ipw-48h}
# FIXES vs the original:
#  * The original modelled P(imv_duration >= 48 h) but then kept hours_mechanically_ventilated_72 >= 48, i.e. patients
#    ventilated >= ~51 h (that column counts outcome hours from hour 4). Both now use run_hrs >= 48.
#  * The completion model now includes language (lang_cat_2): completion can differ by language, and weights that
#    ignore the exposure do not correct for that.
ipw_model_data <- total_cohort_main[!is.na(lang_cat_2)]
ipw_model <- tryCatch(suppressWarnings(glm(reached_48h ~ lang_cat_2 + age_category + sex_category + race_category +
  ethnicity_category + laps2 + factor(hospital_icu_id) + elixhauser_score + factor(observation_year),
  data = ipw_model_data, family = binomial())), error = function(e) NULL)

if (!is.null(ipw_model)) {
  primary_cohort[, prob_reach_48h := predict(ipw_model, newdata = primary_cohort, type = "response")]
  full_48hr_cohort <- primary_cohort[reached_48h == 1 & is.finite(prob_reach_48h)]
  full_48hr_cohort[, ipw := 1 / prob_reach_48h]
  ipw_q <- quantile(full_48hr_cohort$ipw, c(0.01, 0.99), na.rm = TRUE)
  n_winsorized <- full_48hr_cohort[ipw < ipw_q[1] | ipw > ipw_q[2], .N]
  full_48hr_cohort[, ipw := pmin(pmax(ipw, ipw_q[1]), ipw_q[2])]
  full_48hr_cohort <- relevel_cohort(full_48hr_cohort)

  make_table1_pair(dt = full_48hr_cohort, by = "lang_cat_6", reference_level = "english",
    cat_vars = c("sex_category", "race_category", "ethnicity_category", "age_category"), cont_vars = c("laps2", "elixhauser_score"),
    site_name = institution, tables_dir = sedation_tables_dir, institution_prefix = institution,
    cohort_name = "full_48hr_cohort", file_stem = "full_48hr_cohort", project = current_project)
  run_lm("percent_deep_sedation_48", full_48hr_cohort, "sensitivity_model_full_48", "full_48hr_cohort", sedation_sensitivity,
         "sensitivity_analysis_full_48hr", "sensitivity", weights = full_48hr_cohort$ipw, robust = TRUE,
         note = "completed 48 h, IPW for completion, HC3 robust SE")

  # ---- IPW diagnostics for the completed-48-hour analysis (eTables: model, weights, balance) ---------------
  # Each stage runs on its own and is logged, so one failure (e.g. hoslem.test at a small site) does not
  # stop the others. Files go to sensitivity_analyses, next to the IPW model; plots stay local.
  ipw_diag_log <- data.table(site = character(), cohort = character(), stage = character(),
                             status = character(), error = character())
  diag_stage <- function(stage, expr) tryCatch({
    out <- expr
    ipw_diag_log <<- rbind(ipw_diag_log, data.table(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort",
                                                    stage = stage, status = "success", error = NA_character_))
    out
  }, error = function(e) {
    ipw_diag_log <<- rbind(ipw_diag_log, data.table(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort",
                                                    stage = stage, status = "failed", error = conditionMessage(e)))
    message("IPW diagnostics, skipping ", stage, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  # 1) Completion-model data with predicted P(reaching 48 h)
  md <- diag_stage("model_data", {
    d <- ipw_model_data[as.integer(rownames(model.frame(ipw_model)))]
    d[, predicted_prob := fitted(ipw_model)]
    d
  })

  if (!is.null(md)) {
    # 2) Discrimination: c-statistic with 95% CI
    disc <- diag_stage("discrimination", {
      roc_obj <- pROC::roc(md$reached_48h, md$predicted_prob, quiet = TRUE)
      ci <- tryCatch(as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(roc_obj)), error = function(e) rep(NA_real_, 3))
      list(c_stat = as.numeric(pROC::auc(roc_obj)), ci_lb = ci[1], ci_ub = ci[3])
    })
    if (is.null(disc)) disc <- list(c_stat = NA_real_, ci_lb = NA_real_, ci_ub = NA_real_)

    # 3) Calibration: Hosmer-Lemeshow with 10 groups, falling back to 5 when the breaks are not unique
    calib <- NULL
    hl_available <- requireNamespace("ResourceSelection", quietly = TRUE)
    if (!hl_available) diag_stage("hoslem", stop("package ResourceSelection is not installed"))
    if (hl_available) {
      calib <- diag_stage("hoslem_g10", ResourceSelection::hoslem.test(md$reached_48h, md$predicted_prob, g = 10))
      if (is.null(calib))
        calib <- diag_stage("hoslem_g5_fallback", ResourceSelection::hoslem.test(md$reached_48h, md$predicted_prob, g = 5))
    }

    # 4) Event rate overall and by language group
    diag_stage("event_rate", {
      ev <- rbind(md[, .(group = "overall", n = .N, n_reached_48h = sum(reached_48h))],
                  md[!is.na(lang_cat_2), .(n = .N, n_reached_48h = sum(reached_48h)), by = .(group = as.character(lang_cat_2))])
      ev[, pct_reached_48h := fifelse(n_reached_48h >= min_cell, 100 * n_reached_48h / n, NA_real_)]
      ev[, `:=`(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort", n = censor_n(n), n_reached_48h = censor_n(n_reached_48h))]
      fwrite(ev, file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_event_rate_by_lang_full_48hr.csv")))
    })

    # 5) Distribution of predicted probabilities (positivity check), overall and by language group
    diag_stage("prob_distribution", {
      prob_summ <- function(p) list(n = length(p), mean_prob = mean(p), median_prob = median(p), sd_prob = sd(p),
        min_prob = min(p), max_prob = max(p), p1_prob = unname(quantile(p, .01)), p99_prob = unname(quantile(p, .99)),
        n_near_zero = sum(p < 0.05), pct_near_zero = 100 * mean(p < 0.05))
      pr <- rbind(md[, c(list(group = "overall"), prob_summ(predicted_prob))],
                  md[!is.na(lang_cat_2), prob_summ(predicted_prob), by = .(group = as.character(lang_cat_2))])
      pr[n < min_cell, c("mean_prob", "median_prob", "sd_prob", "min_prob", "max_prob", "p1_prob", "p99_prob") := NA_real_]
      pr[n_near_zero > 0 & n_near_zero < min_cell, pct_near_zero := NA_real_]
      pr[, `:=`(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort", n = censor_n(n), n_near_zero = censor_n(n_near_zero))]
      fwrite(pr, file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_predicted_prob_diagnostics_full_48hr.csv")))
    })

    # 6) Summary model diagnostics (one row); c-statistic and H-L are NA if their stages failed
    diag_stage("model_diagnostics_summary", fwrite(data.table(
      site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort",
      n_total = censor_n(nrow(md)), n_reached_48h = censor_n(sum(md$reached_48h)), pct_reached_48h = 100 * mean(md$reached_48h),
      c_statistic = disc$c_stat, c_stat_ci_lb = disc$ci_lb, c_stat_ci_ub = disc$ci_ub,
      hl_chisq  = if (!is.null(calib)) unname(calib$statistic) else NA_real_,
      hl_df     = if (!is.null(calib)) unname(calib$parameter) else NA_real_,
      hl_pvalue = if (!is.null(calib)) calib$p.value else NA_real_,
      hl_note   = if (!hl_available) "ResourceSelection not installed" else
                  if (is.null(calib)) "hoslem.test failed at g = 10 and g = 5; see run log" else NA_character_,
      n_winsorized = censor_n(n_winsorized), trim_lower = unname(ipw_q[1]), trim_upper = unname(ipw_q[2]),
      ess = sum(full_48hr_cohort$ipw)^2 / sum(full_48hr_cohort$ipw^2),
      weight_type = "unstabilized, winsorized at the 1st and 99th percentiles"),
      file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_model_diagnostics_full_48hr.csv"))))
  }

  # 7) Weight distribution in the completed-48-h cohort (after winsorizing), overall and by language group
  diag_stage("weight_distribution", {
    w_summ <- function(w) list(n = length(w), mean_ipw = mean(w), median_ipw = median(w), sd_ipw = sd(w),
      min_ipw = min(w), max_ipw = max(w), p25_ipw = unname(quantile(w, .25)), p75_ipw = unname(quantile(w, .75)),
      p99_ipw = unname(quantile(w, .99)), ess = sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2), ess_pct = 100 * (sum(w)^2 / sum(w^2)) / length(w))
    wd <- rbind(full_48hr_cohort[, c(list(group = "overall"), w_summ(ipw))],
                full_48hr_cohort[!is.na(lang_cat_6), w_summ(ipw), by = .(group = as.character(lang_cat_6))])
    wd[n < min_cell, setdiff(names(wd), c("group", "n")) := NA_real_]
    wd[, `:=`(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort", n = censor_n(n),
              n_winsorized = fifelse(group == "overall", censor_n(n_winsorized), NA_character_),
              trim_lower = unname(ipw_q[1]), trim_upper = unname(ipw_q[2]))]
    fwrite(wd, file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_weight_diagnostics_full_48hr.csv")))
  })

  # 8) Covariate balance, unweighted vs IPW-weighted
  #    (a) Spanish vs English completers (the comparison in the original eTable)
  #    (b) completers vs the whole primary cohort: the comparison completion weights are meant to fix
  #    Continuous SMD: weighted means over the unweighted pooled SD. Categorical: multilevel SMD (Yang & Dalton)
  #    on weighted proportions.
  diag_stage("balance", {
    smd_cont <- function(x, g, w) {
      ok <- !is.na(x); x <- x[ok]; g <- g[ok]; w <- w[ok]
      if (sum(g) < 2 || sum(!g) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      s <- sqrt((var(x[g]) + var(x[!g])) / 2)
      if (!is.finite(s) || s == 0) return(NA_real_)
      (weighted.mean(x[g], w[g]) - weighted.mean(x[!g], w[!g])) / s
    }
    smd_cat <- function(x, g, w) {
      x <- ifelse(is.na(x), "missing", as.character(x))
      levs <- sort(unique(x)); if (length(levs) < 2 || sum(g) < 2 || sum(!g) < 2) return(NA_real_)
      keep <- levs[-1]
      props <- function(sel) vapply(keep, function(l) weighted.mean(x[sel] == l, w[sel]), numeric(1))
      p1 <- props(g); p0 <- props(!g)
      S <- (diag(p1, length(keep)) - tcrossprod(p1) + diag(p0, length(keep)) - tcrossprod(p0)) / 2
      Si <- tryCatch(solve(S), error = function(e) MASS::ginv(S))
      d <- p1 - p0
      sqrt(max(0, as.numeric(t(d) %*% Si %*% d)))
    }
    bal_cat  <- c("sex_category", "race_category", "ethnicity_category", "age_category")
    bal_cont <- c("laps2", "elixhauser_score")
    bal_rows <- function(d, g, w, comparison) rbindlist(c(
      lapply(intersect(bal_cont, names(d)), function(v) data.table(variable = v, variable_type = "continuous",
        smd_unweighted = smd_cont(d[[v]], g, rep(1, nrow(d))), smd_weighted = smd_cont(d[[v]], g, w))),
      lapply(intersect(bal_cat, names(d)), function(v) data.table(variable = v, variable_type = "categorical",
        smd_unweighted = smd_cat(d[[v]], g, rep(1, nrow(d))), smd_weighted = smd_cat(d[[v]], g, w)))))[, comparison := comparison]

    lang_d <- full_48hr_cohort[as.character(lang_cat_6) %in% c("english", "spanish")]
    n_slp_48 <- lang_d[as.character(lang_cat_6) == "spanish", .N]
    bal_lang <- bal_rows(lang_d, as.character(lang_d$lang_cat_6) == "spanish", lang_d$ipw, "spanish_vs_english_completers")
    if (n_slp_48 < min_cell) bal_lang[, c("smd_unweighted", "smd_weighted") := NA_real_]   # small cell

    tv  <- intersect(c(bal_cat, bal_cont), names(primary_cohort))
    tgt <- rbind(full_48hr_cohort[, c(tv, "ipw"), with = FALSE][, grp := TRUE],
                 primary_cohort[, tv, with = FALSE][, `:=`(ipw = 1, grp = FALSE)])
    bal_tgt <- bal_rows(tgt, tgt$grp, tgt$ipw, "completers_vs_primary_cohort")

    balance_dt <- rbind(bal_lang, bal_tgt)
    balance_dt[, `:=`(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort", smd_change = smd_weighted - smd_unweighted,
                      balance_improved = abs(smd_weighted) < abs(smd_unweighted))]
    setcolorder(balance_dt, c("site", "cohort", "comparison", "variable", "variable_type"))
    fwrite(balance_dt, file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_balance_diagnostics_full_48hr.csv")))

    balance_summary <- balance_dt[, .(n_vars_assessed = sum(!is.na(smd_weighted)),
      n_vars_balance_improved = sum(balance_improved, na.rm = TRUE),
      n_vars_smd_below_0.1 = sum(abs(smd_weighted) < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_smd_unweighted = suppressWarnings(max(abs(smd_unweighted), na.rm = TRUE)),
      max_smd_weighted   = suppressWarnings(max(abs(smd_weighted), na.rm = TRUE))), by = comparison]
    balance_summary[, `:=`(site = institution, cohort = "full_48hr_cohort",
                           pct_vars_below_0.1 = fifelse(n_vars_assessed > 0, 100 * n_vars_smd_below_0.1 / n_vars_assessed, NA_real_))]
    for (cc in c("max_smd_unweighted", "max_smd_weighted")) set(balance_summary, which(!is.finite(balance_summary[[cc]])), cc, NA_real_)
    fwrite(balance_summary, file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_balance_summary_full_48hr.csv")))
    print(balance_summary)
  })

  # 9) Local QA plots (not uploaded): weight density and predicted-probability overlap
  diag_stage("plots_local", {
    p1 <- ggplot(full_48hr_cohort[!is.na(lang_cat_6)], aes(x = ipw, fill = lang_cat_6)) +
      geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + geom_vline(xintercept = ipw_q, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
      labs(title = paste0(institution, ": IPW weights, completed-48-h cohort"), x = "Inverse probability weight",
           y = "Density", fill = "Language") + theme_minimal()
    ggsave(file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0(institution, "_ipw_weight_density_full_48hr_LOCAL.png")), p1, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 200)
    if (!is.null(md)) {
      p2 <- ggplot(md[!is.na(lang_cat_2)], aes(x = predicted_prob, fill = lang_cat_2)) +
        geom_density(alpha = 0.5) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0.05, linetype = "dotted", colour = "red") +
        labs(title = paste0(institution, ": predicted P(IMV >= 48 h) by language"), x = "Predicted probability",
             y = "Density", fill = "Language") + theme_minimal()
      ggsave(file.path(intermediate_dir, paste0(institution, "_ipw_predicted_prob_overlap_full_48hr_LOCAL.png")), p2, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 200)
    }
  })

  fwrite(ipw_diag_log, file.path(sedation_sensitivity, paste0(institution, "_ipw_diagnostics_run_log.csv")))
  print(ipw_diag_log)
} else record_result(NULL, "sensitivity_model_full_48", "sensitivity", "full_48hr_cohort", "percent_deep_sedation_48",
                     status = "fit_failed", note = "completion model failed")
```

# 11. Site and hospital characteristics for the heterogeneity analyses (R1.2, R2.2, R2.7)
```{r heterogeneity-characteristics}
# One row per site: language mix of the cohort and of the whole system, hospital types. Rurality is not in CLIF;
# attach it centrally by hospital_id (e.g. RUCA of the hospital ZIP).
site_chars <- data.table(
  site = institution,
  n_elp = censor_n(primary_cohort[lang_cat_6 == "english", .N]),
  n_slp = censor_n(primary_cohort[lang_cat_6 == "spanish", .N]),
  pct_slp_primary_cohort = 100 * primary_cohort[, mean(lang_cat_6 == "spanish")],
  pct_spanish_all_imv    = 100 * total_cohort_main[, mean(lang_cat_2 %in% "spanish")],
  pct_non_english_all_imv = 100 * total_cohort_main[, mean(lang_cat_1 %in% "non-english")],
  n_hospitals = uniqueN(primary_cohort$hosp_for_re), n_icus = uniqueN(primary_cohort$hospital_icu_id),
  pct_community_hospital = 100 * primary_cohort[, mean(tolower(hospital_type) %in% "community")])
fwrite(site_chars, file.path(sedation_heterogeneity, paste0(institution, "_site_characteristics.csv")))
if (!is.null(language_data)) fwrite(language_data, file.path(sedation_heterogeneity, paste0(institution, "_system_language_counts.csv")))

# One row per hospital: n by language and unadjusted mean % deep sedation (shown only when both groups have >= min_cell)
hosp_chars <- primary_cohort[, .(n_elp = sum(lang_cat_6 == "english"), n_slp = sum(lang_cat_6 == "spanish"),
                                 mean_pds_elp = mean(percent_deep_sedation_48[lang_cat_6 == "english"]),
                                 mean_pds_slp = mean(percent_deep_sedation_48[lang_cat_6 == "spanish"]),
                                 hospital_type = hospital_type[1]), by = .(hospital_id = hosp_for_re)]
hosp_chars[n_elp < min_cell | n_slp < min_cell, c("mean_pds_elp", "mean_pds_slp") := NA_real_]
hosp_chars[, `:=`(site = institution, pct_slp = 100 * n_slp / (n_elp + n_slp))]
hosp_chars[n_slp < min_cell, pct_slp := NA_real_]
hosp_chars[, `:=`(n_elp = censor_n(n_elp), n_slp = censor_n(n_slp))]
fwrite(hosp_chars, file.path(sedation_heterogeneity, paste0(institution, "_hospital_characteristics.csv")))

# ICU type and hospital type by language (as before)
fwrite(primary_cohort[, .(count = .N), by = .(lang_cat_6, icu_imv)][order(lang_cat_6, icu_imv)][, count := censor_n(count)],
       file.path(sedation_descriptive, paste0(institution, "_icu_counts_table_1.csv")))
fwrite(primary_cohort[, .(count = .N), by = .(lang_cat_6, hospital_type)][order(lang_cat_6, hospital_type)][, count := censor_n(count)],
       file.path(sedation_descriptive, paste0(institution, "_hospital_type_counts_table_1.csv")))
```
